independence_statement: Fresh read-only reviewer, distinct from the identified translating worker/delegation. I read the complete actual canonical Arabic and both complete final physical-page target files from disk, assessing English against Arabic and Indonesian against Arabic independently. I made no target, tracker, code, reader, Git or remote changes. No reviewer session identifier was exposed; none has been invented. Structural validation and the parent's frozen rebuild were not treated as semantic approval.
